thread:
elaine_cs: looping billing + support — Acme flagged an invoice vs dashboard mismatch for 2025-02-28. Invoice #INV-2025-02-ACME-007 shows 1,246,907 tokens, dashboard shows 1,234,567 (difference 12,340). customer says they changed plan during the day. sending screenshots they attached: https://files.redwood/acme/invoice-snap.png

 tom_support: can you paste acct id and the invoice id here so we can pull logs?

 elaine_cs: acct_834, invoice INV-2025-02-ACME-007. customer noted plan change via self-serve at ~14:22 PST on 2025-02-28. dashboard shows tier 'growth' for the day; invoice charged some usage at 'pro' tier partial day.

 sara_billing: pulling billing run. note: billing batch uses 00:00 UTC cutoffs and proration code normalizes event_time to UTC. two quick hypotheses: (1) proration used webhook event timestamp (customer tz) vs normalized window so partial day counted under wrong tier, (2) token delta could be from raw ingestion vs dedup differences. digging.

 mike_backend: i ran ad-hoc queries against production ingestion and dashboard mv:

```
-- raw ingestion
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='acct_834' AND day='2025-02-28';
-- -> 1246907

-- dashboard materialized view (deduped)
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM daily_usage_mv WHERE account_id='acct_834' AND day='2025-02-28';
-- -> 1234567
```

There are ~12,340 events present in usage_events that have NULL request_id. dashboard mv dedup relies on request_id so those are excluded from daily_usage_mv; billing pipeline queries raw usage_events and counts them.

 tom_support: null request_id? why would billing count events retries/duplicates but dashboard doesn't?

 mike_backend: root cause looks related to smart-router fallback behavior. When capacity fallback triggers we spawn synthetic routed requests and unfortunately a recent change in edge router (release 0.9.3) stopped setting request_id for fallback synthetic requests — so they end up in ingestion with null request_id and unique event_ids. Dashboard dedup step filters nulls, billing ETL doesn't. release 0.9.3 went live 2025-02-28 13:45 UTC which lines up with the customer's plan change window.

 sara_billing: also seeing proration edge: proration calc uses webhook.timestamp for plan-change time; if webhook originates from customer's browser (local tz) it can be off by hours vs normalized UTC window. So two things combined -> invoice shows extra tokens and flipped a portion into higher tier.

 billing-bot: Billing job run bf-20250228-17 completed. invoices_generated=12,346 processed_accounts=3421.

 ryan_infra: i'll open a patch: (1) add fallback_signature dedup in billing ETL so events with null request_id but same fallback_signature are collapsed; (2) make proration use normalized event_time_utc instead of webhook body ts; (3) backfill for affected day. PR and backfill script will be posted in GH.

 tom_support: immediate customer remediation?

 sara_billing: propose one-off credit for token delta and a short note. estimated credit: 12,340 tokens * $0.00006 = $0.7404 -> rounded $0.74. i'll create credit memo CM-2025-02-ACME-834 now.

 mike_backend: opened GH inf-789: add fallback_signature dedup + backfill. quick reproduce steps for QA:
```
1) ingest sample fallback events with null request_id for acct_834 day 2025-02-28
2) run backfill_dedup.py --account acct_834 --day 2025-02-28
3) verify daily_usage_mv sum matches expected deduped total
```

 ryan_infra: i'll schedule the backfill for off-peak tonight and will rerun billing verification after.

 tom_support: assigning final owner -> mike_backend + ryan_infra for code + infra, sara_billing for credit memo, elaine_cs for customer comms. please update this thread when credit issued and backfill complete.

 elaine_cs: will message the customer with: "we found a parsing of fallback requests that caused double-counting in invoices for a small subset of events and a proration mismatch; we're issuing a $0.74 credit and will backfill/dedup on our side. ETA tonight for backfill, confirmation tomorrow." :thumbsup:

 sara_billing: credit memo CM-2025-02-ACME-834 created and queued. amount $0.74.

 mike_backend: backfill run complete (staging simulation successful). will run prod backfill 02:00 UTC. GH link: https://gh.redwood/inf/789

 ryan_infra: prod backfill job started 02:04 UTC, job id bf-backfill-195112. will post summary on completion.

 tom_support: thanks all — keeping this open until final confirmation.

 elaine_cs: confirmed with customer after credit; they acknowledged and said thanks for quick handling. thread clear after prod backfill confirmation. :tada:
